organization.name_ja: 株式会社アドベンチャー

affected.note: Records taken in the server intrusion of 2026-10-02 to 10-04, of which about 4.13 million included hashed member passwords. Two separate incidents were announced at the same time: a business management system breach (17,780 records including duplicates, with refund bank account details) and bus booking completion pages viewable without login (about 12,000 bookings). A follow-up said card data of up to 6,140 people left in old payment logs also leaked.

summary.en: Adventure, operator of the travel booking site skyticket, announced three separate unauthorized access incidents, the largest being an intrusion via a management function between 2026-10-02 and 10-04. About 14.64 million customer records, including names, birthdates, contact details and some hashed passwords, leaked in that intrusion.
summary.ja: 旅行予約サイト「skyticket」を運営するアドベンチャーは、経路の異なる3件の不正アクセスを公表した。最大のものは2026年10月2日から4日にかけて管理機能を不正に操作された事案で、氏名、生年月日、連絡先、一部のハッシュ化されたパスワードなど約1,464万件の顧客情報が流出した。
